responsibility: Implements gm2’s central symbol repository and scope manager. It allocates indexed symbol records for all front-end entities, maintains nested module/procedure scopes using `SymbolKey` trees and auxiliary `Lists`/`Sets`, stores declaration tokens, type relationships, import and export metadata, quad references, built-in/runtime flags, packing information, variable read/write and initialization tracking, and error-scope context, and serves as the shared database consumed by parser passes, constant evaluation, optimization, diagnostics, and GCC tree declaration/code-generation modules.
same_name_distinction: This `.mod` file is the implementation behind the large SymbolTable interface: it defines internal enums and records for symbol kinds and metadata, manages scope/name structures using modules such as `SymbolKey`, `Lists`, and `Sets`, and executes the exported operations that `SymbolTable.def` merely declares.
